messages:
Maria K: Heads up — pages for the `ingest-cpu` alert didn't reach on-call. incident-bot posted an AutoResponder and suppressed the PD page. Seen customer-facing errors on inference-prod (~15% error spike). @Darren (oncall) did you get anything?
Kevin L: I can confirm. Metrics showed spike at 10:12, but no PD page was created. Checked incident-bot logs briefly, looks like duplicate detection matched an earlier alert id and we suppressed the second page.
Kevin L: snippet from incident-bot logs:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:03Z] incident-bot: incoming alert id=ab12cd seq=2 rule=ingest-cpu
[2026-03-17T10:12:03Z] duplicate_detector.v2: matched previous id=ab12cd window=10s reason=rapid-refire
[2026-03-17T10:12:03Z] pager-relay: POST /v1/pages -> 429 Too Many Requests
[2026-03-17T10:12:04Z] incident-bot: suppressed page and recorded suppression_reason=relay_429
```
ops-bot: Pager relay returned 429 at 10:12:03Z and started returning 429s for ~45s; we saw a short burst from the relay when a batch of alerts retried.
Darren (oncall): I didn't receive a mobile page. I saw the slack DM from incident-bot only after Sara manually fired a page. SMS fallback also didn't trigger — looks like both relay and suppression combined.
Sara R: I'm manually routing a page now to the escalation policy and to the secondary on-call. Also enabling PD webhooks retry.
Maria K: Customer impact assessment: inference-prod had ~3 minutes of elevated 503s hitting a subset of customers (we have initial list from logs, roughly 12 customers with high volume). No data loss, but degraded responses.
Kevin L: Short-term mitigation steps applied: 1) temporary disable duplicate suppression for rule `ingest-cpu`; 2) flush pending suppressed pages and retry pagers with exponential backoff removed for the next 5m; 3) bump relay retry quota.
incident-bot: [system] duplicate suppression for rule=ingest-cpu disabled by Kevin L at 2026-03-17T10:15:12Z
Darren (oncall): Got the manual page now, joining bridge. Thanks for the fast manual reroute.
Sara R: Adding runbook note: if relay 429s coincide with duplicate detection, escalate manually. We'll add probe to detect relay 429s and auto-bypass suppression.
Maria K: Filing P0 ticket to track: incident toolchain + relay interaction causing suppressed pages -> missed handoffs. Assigning to eng-infra and eng-sre.
Darren (oncall): I'll run customer impact tally and DM CS for the affected accounts. ETA 30m.
Kevin L: Postmortem action items so far: (A) adjust dedup window heuristics for hot-alert rules; (B) add healthcheck/alert on pager-relay 429 spike; (C) ensure suppressed pages surface to a team-only channel for manual escalation.
Maria K: Good. Marking this thread for postmortem and handoff. :thumbsup:
